summary: The parser accepted a concrete patch component after a minor wildcard when an explicit operator was present, such as >1.*.0, because the rejection guard checked op == Op::Wildcard. The fix tracks the minor wildcard independently of the operator and rejects the following concrete patch component. A verbatim implementation reversal is available, but no detecting upstream test was found at the fixed commit: the fix adds no tests, and existing wildcard and parse-error tests do not exercise this case. The test selector is empty so the candidate remains blocked; no tests were executed.
